title: New England Stories Rechargeable Milk Frother Wand
summary: A handheld milk frother with a dual-spring whisk that charges over USB instead of using batteries. Small enough to keep in a drawer or pack for travel.
pros: Works with dairy and plant milks
cons: Handheld whisk, so foam takes a little technique
Great for drinks, not a replacement for a steam wand

title: Cosori TurboBlaze 6 Qt Air Fryer
summary: A 6-quart, 9-in-1 air fryer with a fast fan, wide temperature range and a ceramic-coated basket. Sized for family meals and covers roasting, baking and reheating.
cons: Large footprint on the counter
Square basket is roomy but check your space

title: KitchenAid All Purpose Kitchen Shears
summary: Kitchen scissors with micro-serrated stainless steel blades and a soft grip, sold with a protective sheath. A simple tool that replaces a knife for lots of small tasks.
cons: Hand washing keeps the edge sharp longer

title: bella 2-Slice Slim Toaster with Long Slot
summary: A slim 2-slice toaster with one extra-long slot, six shade settings and a removable crumb tray. Made for small counters and wider breads.
pros: Long slot fits wide or artisan slices
Six shade settings and cancel button
cons: Single long slot means slices toast side by side, not separately

title: zaa 3-in-1 Kitchen Sink Drain Strainer
summary: A stainless steel sink strainer that also works as a stopper and has a removable basket to catch food scraps. Helps keep the drain from clogging.
pros: Strainer, stopper and odor block in one
Removable basket is easy to empty
cons: Fits standard 3.5 inch US drains only, measure yours first

title: ChefAide 5-Piece Silicone Spatula Set
summary: A set of five one-piece silicone spatulas in different sizes. Heat resistant and gentle on nonstick cookware.
cons: Silicone can stain with strongly colored sauces

title: Electric Salt and Pepper Grinder Set
summary: A battery-powered pair of salt and pepper mills you operate with one hand. Has adjustable coarseness and a small LED light to see what you are seasoning.
cons: Needs batteries
Plastic body, not a traditional mill

title: ASUS NUC 14 Essential Mini PC
summary: A small desktop PC with an Intel N150 processor, 16GB of DDR5 memory and a 512GB SSD, running Windows 11 Pro. Good for office work, browsing and media at very low power.
cons: Entry-level processor, not for heavy gaming or video editing
Memory is a single channel

title: MSI Codex Z2 Gaming Desktop (RTX 5070)
summary: A prebuilt gaming tower with a Ryzen 7 8700F, GeForce RTX 5070, 32GB of DDR5 and a 2TB SSD. Ready to play with Windows 11 Home.
cons: Big and heavy compared to mini PCs
Check the current price against building your own

title: KOTIN Prebuilt Gaming PC (RTX 5070, Ryzen 7 9700X)
summary: A prebuilt gaming PC with an RTX 5070 12GB, Ryzen 7 9700X, 32GB DDR5 and 1TB SSD. Comes with liquid cooling, a strong power supply and a small built-in status display.
cons: Less-known brand than the big names, so read recent buyer reviews
1TB of storage fills up fast

title: Razer Orochi V2 Wireless Gaming Mouse
summary: A compact, lightweight wireless mouse that connects by Bluetooth or Razer HyperSpeed. Runs on a single AA or AAA battery with very long battery life.
cons: Small shape is not ideal for large hands
Uses a replaceable battery, not built-in

title: Razer Basilisk V3 X HyperSpeed Wireless Mouse
summary: A full-size ergonomic wireless mouse with 9 programmable controls, Bluetooth and HyperSpeed connections and RGB lighting.
cons: Right-handed design
Larger and heavier than ultralight mice

title: Razer Viper V3 HyperSpeed Wireless Mouse
summary: An 82g wireless esports-style mouse with a 30K DPI sensor and up to 280 hours of battery life. Built for fast, precise aiming.
cons: Only 6 programmable buttons
Shape favors claw or fingertip grips
